title: Self-Awareness
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child says God made him or her special, that no one is exactly the same, and states his or her gender (Genesis 1:27).

floor.question: What is your name?
floor.answer: The child says his or her name

steps: Say "God made me a boy" or "a girl".

board.do: Wait for the child to say no.
Write: no one is like me.

misconceptions.repair: Compare thumbprints of two children, or two leaves of one tree.

listen_for: No, she is a boy now
misconceptions.ask: A girl has short hair. Is she still a girl?
misconceptions.repair: Say: God made you a boy or a girl; clothes and hair do not change it.
Say Isaiah 43:1 simply: God says, "I have called you by name."
Sing a song about God making me. Read Genesis 1:27 with pictures.
